plain_summary_en: This paper studies Handling troubles with discretion: Transforming informings into announcements in a control room behind a mixed-reality performance. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Handling, Troubles, Discretion, Transforming. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
